results.translated: 10) Attach the green yarn to the FLO of the single crochet stitches worked in the BLO of Round 9 as shown in the image (because the base was turned inside out, the FLO loops remained on the inside), then work 32sc. At the end of each round, join with sl st, ch 1, and continue to the next round.
